version: node 22 image, framework version from the project's package.json
license: isc (oss) - the hosted notebook platform is not

steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

steps.label: up
steps.cmd: docker rm -f spawnables-observable-framework >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --restart unless-stopped --name spawnables-observable-framework -p 8081:8081 -v /opt/spawnables-services/observable-framework:/app node:22-alpine

notes: observable's data apps as static files: the framework is isc and self-hostable, while the observablehq.com notebook platform is a commercial service. so this entry is the framework served from the guest at localhost:8081, and it deliberately does not pretend to be the platform. needs a build step in /opt/spawnables-services/observable before it serves anything.
